title: Verifier collateral
requirements: only the current canonical verifier authority may add collateral for that verifier identity
verifier collateral is native $420 deposited into the registered VAULT_COLLATERAL 420Vault
every deposit is atomically backed by a distinct canonical Vault obligation
position identity is domain-separated by chain, contract, verifier identity, current authority and stake-policy reference
lifecycle revisions with the same authority do not orphan collateral
authority rotation cannot transfer or rewrite the prior authority collateral position
top-ups create immutable backing tranches and advance position revision
activeAmount and slashableAmount equal accumulated live verifier collateral at this step
missing Vault authorization reverts deposit and position mutation atomically
current verifier collateral can be read through IComputeVerifierStakeSource420
